lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular nodes arranged in horizontal rows across the lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a distinct rectangular matrix of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges extend across the mid-lateral flank, marked by a sharp pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of high-luminance circular spots is visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the leading edge and distal region.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a dense field of smaller, more uniform high-intensity spots compared to the larger, grid-aligned blobs on the primary flank.
